pet: Companion animal, not an affectionate nickname for a person
feeding: User-recorded feeding care; never recommend quantities
dosage: Veterinarian-prescribed dosage entered by the user; never calculate or recommend
snooze: Delay the reminder by 15 minutes, not a change to prescribed care
household: People sharing care on this device; no cross-device synchronisation claim
offline: Local pet data works without network; speech and purchases depend on services
